audit_meta.grade_rationale: 4 P1 findings (exceeds C-grade threshold of max_p1: 2). 3 critical CVEs at CVSS 9.8.
audit_meta.skip_reason: Backend service offline at audit time (http://localhost:3001 unreachable)

escalations.title: Handlebars.js — JavaScript code injection via AST type confusion
escalations.fix: npm update handlebars@4.7.9+ in Source/Backend; audit and remove if unused
escalations.escalate_reason: JavaScript code injection / server-side code execution

escalations.title: Protobufjs — remote code execution in orchestrator via proto schema parsing
escalations.escalate_reason: Remote code execution in pipeline orchestrator infrastructure

escalations.title: Vitest UI — arbitrary file read/execute via unprotected test server
escalations.fix: Upgrade vitest to 3.2.6+ in Source/Frontend; run full test suite after major version jump
escalations.escalate_reason: Arbitrary file read and code execution in CI/CD pipeline if vitest UI exposed

p1_findings.title: Traceability enforcer never validates Specifications/ — CI gate has systemic blind spot
p1_findings.detail: The enforcer scans only Plans/*/requirements.md (most recently modified). It never reads Specifications/*.md. CI reports PASS while 10+ FRs for tiered-merge-pipeline and 69+ FRs for portal app go unchecked.
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Developer diverges from Specifications/tiered-merge-pipeline.md. CI gate passes. Spec drift is silently merged.
p1_findings.fix: Expand traceability-enforcer.py to scan all Specifications/*.md; add portal/ to source_dirs; update CLAUDE.md gates

p2_findings.title: Tiered merge pipeline spec entirely unimplemented in Source/
p2_findings.detail: FR-TMP-001–010 have zero // Verifies: comments anywhere in Source/. Features may exist in platform/orchestrator but carry no traceability back to the spec.
p2_findings.fix: Add // Verifies: FR-TMP-* comments to platform/orchestrator (solo-session). Or create Plans/tiered-merge-pipeline/requirements.md shadow file.

p2_findings.title: Duplicate stale root-level test files conflict with comprehensive page-level tests
p2_findings.detail: Root-level tests are stale versions superseded by tests/pages/ versions. Root WorkItemDetailPage.test.tsx mocks `assess: vi.fn()` — an action removed from UI. Both run in CI, creating false confidence.
p2_findings.fix: Delete Source/Frontend/tests/WorkItemDetailPage.test.tsx and WorkItemListPage.test.tsx (root level). Retain tests/pages/ versions.

p2_findings.title: Route handlers bypass service layer — direct store access violates architecture rule
p2_findings.detail: workItems.ts and workflow.ts import directly from ../store/workItemStore. Validation logic (lines 87-117) is in route handlers, making it untestable in isolation.
p2_findings.fix: Create Source/Backend/src/services/workItemService.ts. Move CRUD, validation, and business logic there. Route handlers call service functions only.

p2_findings.title: form-data CRLF injection in multipart encoding
p2_findings.fix: npm update form-data@4.0.6+ (often resolved transitively via express update)

p2_findings.title: Vite path traversal via alternate Windows paths + NTLMv2 hash disclosure
p2_findings.fix: Upgrade vite to 8.1.5+ in Source/Frontend. Check plugin/config compatibility. Resolves esbuild (DEP-006) transitively.

p2_findings.title: esbuild dev server CSRF — any website can read dev server responses
p2_findings.fix: Resolved transitively by upgrading vite to 8.1.5+ (DEP-005 fix)

p2_findings.title: gRPC-js — orchestrator crash on malformed gRPC request (DoS)
p2_findings.fix: Resolved by upgrading @grpc/grpc-js to 1.14.4+ (same fix as DEP-002; solo-session only)

p2_findings.title: path-to-regexp ReDoS via route parameters
p2_findings.fix: npm update path-to-regexp@0.1.13+ (often resolved transitively via express 4.22.2+)

p2_findings.title: ws WebSocket memory exhaustion DoS via tiny fragments
p2_findings.fix: npm update ws@8.21.0+ (usually resolved transitively via vitest upgrade DEP-003)

p2_findings.title: picomatch ReDoS via extglob quantifiers + method injection
p2_findings.fix: Update picomatch and dependent packages (micromatch, anymatch) to picomatch@2.3.2+ or 4.0.4+

p3_findings.title: Undocumented eslint-disable suppressions (react-hooks/exhaustive-deps)
p3_findings.fix: Add inline comments explaining why the dep array is intentionally incomplete, or fix the exhaustive-deps violations.

p3_findings.title: Specifications/workflow-engine.md has no FR-XXX requirement identifiers
p3_findings.fix: Add FR-WE-001, FR-WE-002, etc. to each requirement row. Add // Verifies: FR-WE-* to relevant source files.

p3_findings.title: portal/ app FRs (FR-001–069) never enforced against portal/ codebase
p3_findings.fix: Add portal/ to source_dirs in traceability-enforcer.py. (Part of QO-001 fix scope.)

p3_findings.title: @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node — Prometheus exporter crash on malformed requests
@opentelemetry/core unbounded memory via W3C Baggage header flooding
p3_findings.fix: Update @opentelemetry/core to 2.8.0+ (requires major sdk-node version bump)

p3_findings.title: brace-expansion process hang / memory exhaustion via zero-step sequences
p3_findings.fix: Update brace-expansion to 1.1.13+ (auto-resolved via dependency updates)

p3_findings.title: react-router open redirect via protocol-relative URLs
postcss CSS injection → XSS via unescaped </style> in stringify
uuid version fragmentation across workspaces (no active CVE)
p3_findings.fix: Consolidate all uuid usage to 9.0.1+ via workspace coordination

p3_findings.title: express — 4 minor versions behind v4 line; v5 available
p3_findings.fix: npm update express in Source/Backend (v4 line: 4.18.2 → 4.22.2). Plan v5 migration separately.

p3_findings.title: pino — 2 major versions behind (8.17.0, latest 10.3.1)
p3_findings.fix: Evaluate pino@10.x migration; test logging compatibility

p3_findings.title: React + React-DOM locked at v18; v19 available
react-router-dom locked at v6; v7 available
p3_findings.fix: Evaluate react-router v6→v7 migration (routing API refactor required)

p3_findings.title: Large transitive dependency graph (~800+ unique packages) — wide CVE surface
p3_findings.fix: Run npm audit --workspaces in CI. Generate SBOM. Prune unused dependencies. Audit why handlebars is in Backend.

p3_findings.title: Monorepo fragmentation — 10 package.json files with no shared audit coordination
p3_findings.fix: Add npm audit --workspaces to CI/CD. Pin transitive dependency versions in root package-lock.json.

p4_findings.title: Source packages marked UNLICENSED — acceptable for internal project
Source/E2E package licensed under ISC (permissive, acceptable)

cross_reference_map.root_cause: Outdated Frontend dev toolchain (vite / vitest / esbuild)
cross_reference_map.single_fix: Upgrade vitest@3.2.6+ and vite@8.1.5+ in Source/Frontend — resolves esbuild transitively
Upgrade @grpc/grpc-js@1.14.4+ in platform/orchestrator (solo-session only) — transitively pins protobufjs@7.5.5+

cross_reference_map.root_cause: Traceability enforcer scope gap (does not scan Specifications/ or portal/)
cross_reference_map.single_fix: Expand traceability-enforcer.py to scan all Specifications/*.md and add portal/ to source_dirs
Run npm update express to 4.22.2+ in Source/Backend — resolves form-data and path-to-regexp transitively

grading.reason: 4 P1 findings exceeds C-grade maximum of 2. Driven entirely by 3 critical CVSS 9.8 CVEs in the dependency tree. Application code quality (plans coverage, test hygiene, observability) is B-grade.
